verses.text: Hear now what YHWH is saying: “Arise, dispute with the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

segments.text: Hear now what YHWH is saying: “Arise, dispute with the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.

verses.text: Hear, O mountains, the dispute of YHWH, and you enduring foundations of the earth, for a dispute [is] unto YHWH against His people, and He will argue against Israel.

segments.text: Hear, O mountains, the dispute of YHWH, and you enduring foundations of the earth, for a dispute [is] unto YHWH against His people, and He will argue against Israel.

verses.text: ‘My people, what have I done to you, and how have I wearied you? Answer Me!

segments.text: ‘My people, what have I done to you, and how have I wearied you? Answer Me!

verses.text: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery; I redeemed you and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

segments.text: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery; I redeemed you and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

verses.text: My people, remember, please, what Balak king of Moab counseled, and what Balaam son of Beor answered him—from Shittim unto Gilgal, so that you may know the righteous acts of YHWH!’”

segments.text: My people, remember, please, what Balak king of Moab counseled, and what Balaam son of Beor answered him—from Shittim unto Gilgal, so that you may know the righteous acts of YHWH!’”

verses.text: With what will I come before YHWH [and] bow myself before God Most High? Will I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves, sons of a year?

segments.text: With what will I come before YHWH [and] bow myself before God Most High? Will I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves, sons of a year?

verses.text: Will YHWH be pleased with thousands of rams, with myriad rivers of oil? Will I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body [for] the sin of my soul?

segments.text: Will YHWH be pleased with thousands of rams, with myriad rivers of oil? Will I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body [for] the sin of my soul?

verses.text: He has shown to you, O man, what [is] good. And what does YHWH seek from you, but to do justice and to love kindness, and to be humble to walk with your God?

segments.text: He has shown to you, O man, what [is] good. And what does YHWH seek from you, but to do justice and to love kindness, and to be humble to walk with your God?

verses.text: The voice of YHWH calls to the city, and wisdom fears Your name: “Heed the rod, and the One who has appointed it!

segments.text: The voice of YHWH calls to the city, and wisdom fears Your name: “Heed the rod, and the One who has appointed it!

verses.text: Are there Yet, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness, and the ephah of leanness, which is accursed?

segments.text: Are there Yet, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness, and the ephah of leanness, which is accursed?

verses.text: Shall I count pure [one] with scales of wickedness, and with a bag of weights of deceit?

segments.text: Shall I count pure [one] with scales of wickedness, and with a bag of weights of deceit?

verses.text: How her rich men are full of violence, and her dwellers have spoken deception, and their tongue [is] deceitful in their mouth!

segments.text: How her rich men are full of violence, and her dwellers have spoken deception, and their tongue [is] deceitful in their mouth!

verses.text: So also I will be severe in striking you, to make [you] desolate over your sins!

segments.text: So also I will be severe in striking you, to make [you] desolate over your sins!

verses.text: You will eat, and you will not be satisfied, your emptiness [is] in your entrails; you will put away, and you will not save, and what you save, I will give to the sword.

segments.text: You will eat, and you will not be satisfied, your emptiness [is] in your entrails; you will put away, and you will not save, and what you save, I will give to the sword.

verses.text: You will sow, and you will not reap; you will tread the olives, and you will not anoint yourselves with oil, and new wine, and you will not drink the wine.

segments.text: You will sow, and you will not reap; you will tread the olives, and you will not anoint yourselves with oil, and new wine, and you will not drink the wine.
